### Day 66: 2 Samuel 16:1–4
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-66-2-samuel-16-14.html
Passage: 2 Samuel 16:1-4
Points:
- Opportunists often seek to exploit and manipulate believers when they are vulnerable and facing personal crises.
- Having already suffered Absalom's betrayal, David was primed to believe the worst about Mephibosheth without verifying the claims.
- High stress and emotional anguish impair spiritual discernment, causing people to react hastily rather than respond with wisdom.
- Seeking wise, godly counsel is vital during painful seasons to avoid making rash assumptions and damaging decisions.
